text:
maya_growth: Quick sync: launching a set of "refapp quickstarts" next month. Goal: low-friction OSS onboarding + 200 repo stars in 30 days. ideas for distribution?

leo_devrel: love it. suggest 3 short tutorials (setup, run benchmarks, deploy to prod). each with a 5-7min vid + repo tag.

maya_growth: yep. pairing those with two push channels: newsletter + targeted tweets. felix, can you make 3 thumbnail variants?

felix_design: on it. will do hero + dark mode thumbnail. want to test two taglines: "Refapp in 30" vs "From repo to prod".

anya_research: benchmark narrative idea: show latency/cost before and after enabling batching + KV cache. headline: "2.3x cost reduction at tail latencies" — i'll validate numbers.

simon_analytics: make sure we instrument UTM + event for "quickstart_start" and "quickstart_complete". I can add a conversion funnel in GA and HubSpot.

maya_growth: inbound lead routing: if someone selects "request help" on the quickstart page, route to se_assist@redwood.ai and tag contact with "quickstart_help". who will add that to the form?

leo_devrel: I can update Netlify form mapping today. Will include email, company_size, use_case, demo_request boolean.

deploybot: Deploy queued: quickstart-landing v1 -> staging at 2027-07-10T14:00Z.

felix_design: thumbnails done by EOD tomorrow. sending variants to #marketing-review.

anya_research: ran a small internal run: baseline cost/token 0.0032 USD, with batching+cache 0.0013 USD. saving ~59%. will export chart and a short blurb for the blog.

maya_growth: that stat is gold. we'll use one hero stat for socials and a more detailed table in the blog. please keep the chart simple: time on x, cost/token on y.

simon_analytics: for A/B we should test CTAs: A) "Start the quickstart" B) "Get a guided demo". tracking will report by week+7.

leo_devrel: schedule for tutorials: Week 1: repo setup + minimal example. Week 2: benchmarks + optimize. Week 3: deploy + monitoring. we can fast-track one for the demo event.

maya_growth: webinar? short 30m live walkthrough on launch day + office hours next day. target Wed 17:00 UTC.

felix_design: Ill make banner + social square. need final copy by tomorrow noon.

simon_analytics: adding form mapping: utm_source, utm_campaign, email, company, job_title, quickstart_step. I'll add a HubSpot property "quickstart_status" for triage.

leo_devrel: for socials, we should publish three clips from the live walkthrough: 30s, 45s, 90s. keep caption templates reusable.

maya_growth: good. maya: action items recap? (1) thumbnails + banner (felix) (2) benchmark chart + blurb (anya) (3) form mapping + HubSpot prop (simon + leo) (4) landing copy + UTMs (maya) (5) staging deploy (deploybot).

felix_design: confirmed.

anya_research: will share numbers and CSV by EOD Friday.

leo_devrel: Ill wire the Netlify form this afternoon and post the updated mapping here.

deploybot: Deploy success: quickstart-landing v1 -> staging at 2027-07-10T14:02Z.

maya_growth: awesome. small ask: include a short "what success looks like" checkbox on the form ("ready for POC", "just exploring"). helps with lead scoring.

simon_analytics: done. I mapped those to HubSpot lead_score rules.

maya_growth: thanks all. will open a public sheet for tracking PR + socials. ping here when assets are up. :rocket:
